{{Quote|This is D-4. It's the farthest from D-1."<br />"Rather like Tatooine in that respect.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
'''''Dreadnaught-Four''''', '''''D-Four''''' for short, was the fourth of six [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] used on ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.

==History==
It came directly off of the [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] line for use on the project in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. During ''Outbound Flight''{{'s}} journey, ''Dreadnaught-Four'' was commanded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Omano]] and its [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contingent was led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Justyn Ma'Ning]].
